draft.body:
I am Justin Mascarenhas, and I have an M.S. in Computer Engineering from Rochester Institute of Technology. I saw your repost about MOBY hiring in Miami and wanted to message you about the Computer Vision & Perception Engineer role, since most of my work has been perception that has to run on Jetson hardware.

For my capstone at RIT I built a robotic arm that picks up objects using vision, with a YOLO detector I optimized in TensorRT on a Jetson. It ran fast enough for visual servoing, which was the whole point. I also write CUDA C++ kernels. Before that, at Bhabha Atomic Research Centre, I built an inspection pipeline for microscopic metal cracks that combined image stitching, wavelet denoising and monocular depth estimation to reconstruct the surface in 3D. That mix of perception on edge hardware and offline reconstruction is close to the two halves of this role.

If my background looks like a fit, would you be open to referring me for the position?
draft.sign_off: Thank you so much in advance.
draft.hook_used: Abrar (Founding Engineer, 1st connection) reposted MOBY's hiring post listing the Computer Vision & Perception Engineer role
